meta.name: Ultron world-realism layer: environment state, local fog, FX lights, Niagara VFX, distortion, Chaos destruction
meta.author: Ultron (contrib/ultron/world_realism)
meta.target: RTX 2070 SUPER 8 GB, 1080p output, 60 fps, Lumen SWRT High (contrib/ultron/perf_budget.md)

units.distance: cm unless the key ends in _m or _km
units.time: seconds unless the key ends in _ms
units.luminance: cd/m2 (nits). Material emissive = nits / ima.EmissiveNitsPerUnit (project cvar, default 1000)
units.light_intensity: candela for point/spot FX lights (UE IntensityUnits=Candelas)

layering: 2. contrib/vison/lighting_presets.json (sun 120000 lux / 5900 K, moon, sky light, EV100 exposure, camera)
3. contrib/vison/postprocess_realism.json (SkyAtmosphere, VolumetricCloud, ExponentialHeightFog + volumetric fog, Lumen, post)
4. THIS FILE: what Vison does not cover. World wetness/weather MPC, Local Fog Volumes, FX light pool, Niagara, distortion, Chaos. Keyed by Vison's preset ids; never re-specifies a key Vison owns.
meta._sun_sky_changes_note: No sun, moon, sky light, SkyAtmosphere, cloud, height-fog or exposure value is changed by this layer. Vison's exposure needs no resync.

ultron_world_realism: Local Fog Volumes (fire, smoke, dust pockets)
FX light pool look (intensity, colour, light function)
vison: sun, moon, sky light, SkyAtmosphere, VolumetricCloud, ExponentialHeightFog + volumetric fog values
PostProcessVolume incl. Lumen quality, bloom, local exposure, motion blur
u: static suit paint / metal: contrib/u/suit_materials.json -> M_CarPaint, M_ArcGlow
dume: audio, CC0 environment assets in contrib/dume/assets

Wetness.use: surface water film on world materials: roughness *= lerp(1, 0.08..0.15, Wetness) on porous, albedo darkening up to 30% (concrete/asphalt), 0% on metal

PuddleCoverage.use: threshold on a height/cavity mask: where mask < PuddleCoverage the surface becomes standing water (roughness 0.02, specular F0 0.02, albedo -> 0.3x, normal flattened)

RainIntensity.use: 0 dry, 0.3 drizzle (~1 mm/h), 1 heavy (~25 mm/h). Drives ripple normals in puddles, streaks on verticals, rain Niagara spawn, and Jocasta's suit Wetness build (rainPerSec * RainIntensity)

WindSpeed.use: m/s at 10 m. Smoke/rain drift, debris flutter, flag/tarp WPO amplitude

DustAmount.use: airborne dust motes + ground dust layer on up-facing surfaces

AshFall.use: falling ash particles + grey ash layer on up-facing surfaces

LightningFlash.use: 0..1 envelope written by the storm script; drives cloud emissive and a sky-light boost (see lightning)

DebrisDensity.use: scatter density of static rubble/debris decals and meshes

WindDirection.use: XY unit vector in world space

EmissiveNitsPerUnit.use: mirror of the project cvar ima.EmissiveNitsPerUnit so VFX materials convert nits -> emissive the same way as the rest of the game

HeatHazeScale.use: global multiplier on all distortion materials (0 = accessibility / Low tier)

DistortionMaxUV.use: hard clamp on screen-UV offset (1.2% of screen) so haze never smears HUD-sized detail

ScorchFadeTime.use: seconds for impact scorch decals to fade

LastBlastTime.use: world time of the most recent big explosion (shockwave ring in heat-haze material)

LastBlastPosRadius.use: xyz = world position, w = radius in cm, for shockwave distortion and dust kick-up

NPC_WorldWeather._note: SourceMaterialCollection makes the NPC mirror every MPC scalar/vector, so gameplay writes the MPC only.

preset_world_state._how: Written to MPC_WorldWeather when a Vison preset is applied (build_world_rig.py --preset, or at runtime next to ContribLighting::Apply). Local fog volumes are placed relative to the play space; they use the existing volumetric fog (r.LocalFogVolume.RenderIntoVolumetricFog=1).

prologue.notes: Indoor dust in tungsten beams; Vison's lake-mist second fog layer stays his.

workshop.notes: Light dust only so skylight shafts read; glossy floor stays dry.

rooftops.notes: Rooftop gravel, HVAC; a few old puddles from roof ponding.

city.notes: Dry, clean daylight. Realism comes from road grime decals, oil stains, tyre marks, curb dirt.

ruins.notes: Dust-coated everything; burst water main puddles.

titan_battlefield.notes: Fire-lit smoke: Local Fog Volumes with emissive replace volumetric-fog emissive (Vison keeps it 0).

finale.notes: Dew + firefighting water after the battle; low sun skims wet ground for long specular streaks.

rooftops_storm.notes: Heavy rain: ripples, sheeting on verticals, rain Niagara, splash on surfaces and on the suit.

city_night.notes: After rain: no ripples (RainIntensity 0) so puddles are mirrors for sodium/LED lamps. This is Vison's key look; it depends on these puddles.

city_overcast.notes: Damp, occasional drizzle; uniformly darkened asphalt with soft sky reflections.

local_fog_volumes._cap: <= 6 visible (r.LocalFogVolume.TileMaxInstanceCount stays 32). Cost ~0.05-0.1 ms each at High [E].

smouldering_fire_glow._emissive_note: FogEmissive is linear radiance scaled by Vison's EV; ~1 reads as a dim ember glow at EV 9-12

fire_glow_large.pair_with: one unshadowed pooled point light, 2e5 cd, 2000 K, radius 2500

lightning.implementation: Scale the EXISTING moon/sky light only (no extra light): SkyLight intensity *= 1 + 40*LightningFlash and cloud material emissive += LightningFlash. Vison's histogram Min EV clamp keeps auto-exposure from pumping. Thunder delay = distance_m / 343 (Dum-e).
lightning._note: This is a runtime multiplier on Vison's value, not a change to it.

emissive_reference_nits._physics: Blackbody luminance (Planck x CIE V(lambda)) computed for this file: 1000 K 2.5, 1200 K 130, 1500 K 7.5e3, 1800 K 1.2e5, 2000 K 4.6e5, 2500 K 5.6e6 cd/m2. Hydrocarbon fireball soot radiates at ~1100-1600 K effective (emissivity 0.6-1). Scene mid-grey luminance = 0.125 * 2^EV100: 6000 nits at EV 15.55 (city noon), 776 at EV 12.6, 1.5 at EV 3.6 (storm night).
emissive_reference_nits._consequence: A real fireball is only ~1-3 stops over mid-grey in noon sun (it reads orange, not white) but 12+ stops over at night (blinding). Keep these physical values and let Vison's exposure do the rest; do not scale FX per preset.
emissive_reference_nits.arc_glow_reference: U's suit reactor intensity 12 units -> 12000 nits; keep repulsor halo below the reactor so the suit stays the hero light

fx_light_pool._source: UArenaFXPool already caps FX lights at 16 (MaxFXLights). This section is the LOOK of those 16, not a new system.

hero_exceptions.who: the two largest live explosions (radius >= 300 cm) so Lumen bounces fire light off the ground
hero_exceptions.cost: ~0.1-0.2 ms each in Lumen scene lighting [E]

fx_light_pool._volumetric_note: Lets explosions light Vison's volumetric fog/smoke. Unshadowed lights inject cheaply; keep r.VolumetricFog.InjectShadowedLightsSeparately default.

repulsor_bolt.note: I = L x pi r^2 = 6e4 x pi x 9 cm^2 ~ 1.5e3 cd (matches IronProjectile Glow 1500)

unibeam.note: use a spot along the beam: 1 light, not per segment

explosion_small.envelope: peak in 1 frame, 0.15 at 0.2 s, 0 at 0.6 s

explosion_large.envelope: flash 6e5 cd for 50 ms, then 2e5 decaying to 0 by 1.5 s

impact_sparks._why: too small and short; emissive only

thruster.note: one light per suit (boots share it), placed between the feet; not counted per boot

light_functions._how: UE 5.8 Light Function Atlas (r.LightFunctionAtlas=1, on by default) packs light-function materials into one atlas, so every pooled light can reuse the same 2 materials without the per-light light-function pass. Point/spot light functions are sampled by deferred lighting, volumetric fog and Lumen through the atlas.

MLF_FXFlicker.inputs: per-light seed via LightFunction scale or position hash

niagara._global_caps: perf_budget.md §6.3: <=2000 CPU particles, <=50000 GPU particles, <=1500 sprites within 10 m, average overdraw <=4 layers, particle lights <=4 (and ALL of them inside the 16-light pool budget). Spawn scale 0.5 at Effects Medium/Low via r.EmitterSpawnRateScale.

NS_Thruster_Boot.sim: GPU for plume sprites, CPU for the 1 ribbon
NS_Thruster_Boot.attach: suit sockets foot_l_jet / foot_r_jet (+ palm_l/palm_r in hover). Owner: AIronManCharacter; parameters from the existing thrust value 0..1

shock_diamonds.note: Mach disks only appear at high thrust, which is why they look real: ramp them in, do not show at idle

heat_haze.velocity: along exhaust 600 cm/s + buoyancy 150 cm/s up

NS_Repulsor_Blast.attach: palm_l / palm_r muzzle; bolt follows the pooled AIronProjectile

charge.type: inward-converging sparks x12 + palm ring sprite

bolt.motion_blur: rely on velocity (r.Translucency.Velocity=1); do not stretch sprites twice

impact.spawn: on hit -> NS_Impact_Sparks variant 'energy' + scorch decal 30 cm

NS_Unibeam.attach: chest reactor socket (U: glow.reactor); beam end = hit point

charge.type: reactor bloom-up: emissive ramp 12000 -> 250000 nits + inward particles x40

beam.type: beam/ribbon renderer, 3 strands, radius 12-18 cm, UV-panned noise

hit_splash.type: sparks GPU 300/s + molten droplets CPU 30/s with gravity, collision = depth buffer

hit_scorch.type: growing decal 30->120 cm while held, fades over ScorchFadeTime

NS_Missile.attach: missile actor (pooled hostile shots); Titan launchers

smoke_trail.type: GPU sprites, lit translucent (Lumen translucency volume)

ribbon.type: CPU ribbon, 0.6 s, for continuity at distance

NS_Explosion_Small.use: drone death, missile hit, tank shell

fireball.type: flipbook 8x8 sprites x6, emissive by temperature ramp (2000 K -> 1100 K)

smoke.type: lit GPU sprites x30, albedo 0.08-0.15 (soot is nearly black), size 100->400 cm, rise 120 cm/s, opacity 0.7->0

sparks.type: GPU x120, velocity 1500-3500 cm/s, gravity -980, drag 1.5, depth-buffer collision, restitution 0.3

debris.type: Niagara mesh particles x12 (no physics bodies), collision = depth buffer

shockwave.type: distortion ring, speed 34000 cm/s (speed of sound), strength 0.8, writes MPC_WorldFX.LastBlast*

NS_Explosion_Large.use: tank cook-off, Titan death, phase breaks, building GC break

fireball.type: flipbook sprites x10 + 1 rising mushroom (toroidal velocity field)

smoke.type: lit GPU sprites x60, albedo 0.06-0.12, size 300->1200 cm, rise 250 cm/s, WorldWeather wind

debris.type: Niagara mesh particles x30 + up to the destruction budget of real physics bodies (see chaos)

stages.local_fog: spawn a temporary fire_glow_large Local Fog Volume for 4 s if fewer than 6 are visible

water.condition: PuddleCoverage > 0 and hit in puddle mask

NS_Impact_Sparks.orientation: cone around surface normal reflected about incoming direction, 35 deg

NS_Rain.TSR_note: rain is translucent: set 'Output Velocity' on the material so TSR does not ghost it

NS_DustMotes.note: only visible in light shafts; lit translucency

enemy_damage_vfx._source: contrib/jocasta/combat_realism.json enemyDamage.* (thresholds, timings, piece counts are hers; only the look is defined here)

drone.smokeBelow.look: GPU sprites 30/s, grey-black albedo 0.1, size 10->80 cm, lifetime 1.5 s, trails in world space

drone.death.system: trail NS_DamageSmoke_Thick during the 0.6-1.2 s spiral -> NS_Explosion_Small on impact/timeout
drone.death.debris: her 3 pieces are physics bodies; add 8 Niagara mesh shards

tank.fireBelow.look: flipbook fire 3 sprites + black smoke column (albedo 0.04) 40/s, Local Fog Volume smouldering_fire_glow, no light (pool full in fights)

tank.death.system: NS_Explosion_Small at death, then NS_Explosion_Large at her cookOffDelaySec (0.4 s) at the turret ring; turret = 1 physics body; hull keeps NS_EngineFire for her wreckLifeSec (20 s) then smoke-only fade

boss.phase2Break.system: NS_PlateShear (sparks 150 + metal tear streaks) at each shoulder plate
boss.phase2Break.exposed_frame_glow: her [1.0, 0.25, 0.1] at 1500 nits (~1250 K hot steel), cools to 400 nits over 8 s

boss.phase3Break.system: NS_PlateShear at chest + arm-cannon spark trail NS_DamageSparks_Trail (CPU, 15/s)

boss.ramHeatTint.look: leading-edge heat haze sprites (M_HeatHaze_Sprite, strength 0.5) while dashing

boss.death.system: NS_Explosion_Large delayed to the end of her slow-mo; 3 secondary NS_Explosion_Small over 1.2 s

distortion._how: Desktop deferred: refraction in translucent materials (Refraction Method 'Pixel Normal Offset' with Normal from a scrolling noise). Rendered in the distortion pass after translucency; no global cvar (r.DisableDistortion is mobile-only). Strength is clamped by MPC_WorldFX.DistortionMaxUV and scaled by HeatHazeScale.

M_HeatHaze_Sprite.normal: 2 octaves panning noise, 0.6 and 1.7 cycles per sprite, upward pan 0.8/s
M_HeatHaze_Sprite.strength: particle alpha x 0.006 UV x HeatHazeScale

M_ShockwaveRing.shape: ring normal from radial gradient, width 8% of radius

M_HeatHaze_Volume.use: unibeam surround, Jocasta's 'heat-shimmer cone under the boot thrusters' in hover
M_HeatHaze_Volume._jocasta: her suit_reactive_state motion.hover.thrusterShimmer = 'screen-space distortion' is THIS material; one owner

rules: never distort the HUD (UMG is composited after; nothing to do)
never place haze within 50 cm of the camera (fade by camera distance 50-150 cm)
no haze sprites at Effects Low; Medium = 50% spawn
haze is invisible against flat sky: fade by scene-depth difference so it only shows where background has detail

chaos._plugin_note: GeometryCollectionPlugin and FieldSystemPlugin are EnabledByDefault=false in the 5.8 install. Adding them to IronManArena.uproject (+ GeometryCollectionEngine / FieldSystemEngine in Build.cs only if C++ touches them) is a game-source change for the merger.

physics_body_cap._source: Jocasta combat_realism.json perf.maxPhysicsDebris (scene-wide, oldest removed first, sleep after 1.5 s)
physics_body_cap.overflow: anything beyond the cap is Niagara mesh debris (GPU, no rigid body)

geometry_collection_defaults._damage_note: Chaos strain units: rough guide. Level 0 only breaks from big explosions (field strain), level 1 from repulsor/unibeam, level 2 from anything. Tune per material.

component.CollisionProfile: Destructible: ignore Pawn and Projectile channels

fracture_attributes.small_piece_collision: pieces < 15 cm -> no collision (Implicit None) and removed in 2 s

cover_pillar.note: gameplay cover: breaking it changes combat; get design sign-off

facade_chunk.fracture: Planar cuts along panel lines + Voronoi 8 per panel

street_lamp.not_gc: rigid body knock-over (1 body) + light off + spark burst; cheaper than fracture

fields.explosion: Radial Falloff strain (Magnitude = 2e5 x (radius_cm/450)) + Radial Vector velocity 1500 cm/s, one-shot via AFieldSystemActor pooled per explosion (max 2 live)
fields.repulsor: Uniform strain 8e4 at hit point radius 60

chaos.debris_dust: ChaosNiagara 'Chaos Destruction' data interface spawns dust per break event: <=40 sprites per break, ET_Debris
chaos.lumen_note: Broken GC pieces have no mesh distance field until rest; Lumen falls back to the global SDF for them. Fine for small pieces; for facade chunks keep the parent mesh until break.

environment_dressing.assets_from_dume: contrib/dume/assets/manifest.json (CC0). glTF is Y-up, 1 unit = 1 m: import with uniform scale 100 and convert axis (Interchange glTF importer does this).

asphalt.wet_response: porous: roughness 0.85 -> 0.15 at Wetness 1, albedo x0.6
asphalt.puddle_mask: height map inverted + large-scale noise (5-10 m) so puddles collect in ruts and near curbs

facades.wet_response: streaks: vertical rain-streak mask x RainIntensity, roughness down 40% only where streaked

decals.grime: oil stains, tyre marks, drain streaks, curb dirt: DBuffer decals, Normal+Roughness+Color
decals.combat: scorch (explosions), impact chips, bullet holes: pooled, max 64 live, fade over MPC_WorldFX.ScorchFadeTime
decals.wetness_interaction: decals must also read MPC_WorldWeather.Wetness so scorch marks get wet too

hdris._note: Vison's workshop preset already uses the project HDRI. Dum-e's puresky HDRIs are for lookdev / reflection fallback only; do not replace the real-time SkyAtmosphere capture in outdoor presets.

budget_estimate_ms_high._label: ESTIMATE [E], RTX 2070S, 1080p out, TSR ~67-75%; not measured. Fits inside perf_budget §1 'Translucency / FX / distortion 0.6 ms' only for typical fights; the heavy case borrows from Ultron's 1.5 ms reserve.
budget_estimate_ms_high._note_vison: Vison estimates city at 16.0 ms High before VFX. Combined that is over 16.67 ms in heavy fights unless dynamic res drops to ~60-67%. This is a real risk; measure with perf_budget §11 before adding Epic extras.

epic_tier_extras._opt_in: Only at sg.EffectsQuality=3 (and the in-game 'Epic' preset). Expected 45 fps per Vison's Epic estimate.

items.hero_lumen_bounce: 4 hero explosion lights with IndirectLightingIntensity 1 instead of 2
items.debris: Niagara mesh debris x2 (never more physics bodies: still 24)
items.heterogeneous_volumes: not recommended even at Epic (SVT smoke ~3-6 ms on Turing)
